name: Standing Below The Stars
source:
"Everything has a reason, all you need is some context"

You are assigned to guide an unfortunate soul through a treacherous and fantastical adventure across the four regions of Willowdale. The soul lost his memories regarding his past and could only rely on his present to save his future. So, you'll need to use common sense, a pinch of gut instincts, and a hint of luck. Your choices! Determine how others view this soul. Make Reasonable Choices! In order to make his mark on this world. It is advised to guide him based on your knowledge about him alone; but here's the catch, your knowledge about the soul is the same as the lost soul himself.

[From [url=https://waterdropyt.itch.io/standing-below-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“一切都有原因，你所需要的只是一些背景”

你被指派引导一个不幸的灵魂穿越威洛代尔的四个地区，经历一场危险而奇幻的冒险。灵魂失去了对过去的记忆，只能依靠现在来拯救自己的未来。因此，你需要运用常识、一点直觉和一点运气。你的选择！确定其他人如何看待这个灵魂。做出合理选择！为了在这个世界上留下自己的印记。建议仅根据你对他的了解来指导他；但这里有一个问题，你对灵魂的了解与迷失的灵魂本身是一样的。

[来自[url=https://waterdropyt.itch.io/standing-below-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
